# Project Governance 4.5.5

The existing cleanup continuation can now reconcile an original physical XCTest workflow after its
tester was removed. It verifies the original app/XCTest and container identity, fresh same-phone
absence, host/file guard closure and exact original lease generation before normal reconciliation.

No ordinary stage reruns, replacement claim, app install/stop, resource alias or new public adapter
is introduced. Original failed native evidence remains unchanged, and unrelated live holders keep
their claims. Earlier observation-only and installed-app cleanup routes retain their strict rules.
This release does not automatically upgrade projects or turn cleanup into task acceptance.

Qualification follows the normal 4.x local release path. Opus5.5 high review was reconciled;
30 focused source tests, 63 affected installed tests and exact clean-archive proof pass. GitHub CI
is skipped. Offline package proof does not establish ordinary development acceptance or device proof.
